::: {#rem-short-codes-for-common-symbols}
#### Short codewords for common values

A code with a small expected length gives frequent values short codewords
and rare values long ones.
Morse code, which uses dots and dashes rather than binary digits,
works the same way:
it spends a single dot on "E", the most common letter in English,
and four signals on the rare "Z".

:::
